verdict.rationale: Probes confirm threejs.org serves llms.txt at the site root (HTTP 200). That file points to a docs llms.txt with an explicit '## Instructions for Large Language Models' section and a 363 KB llms-full.txt of the complete docs, and the docs llms.txt carries agent-oriented guidance such as 'CORRECT - modern pattern', import-map advice and WebGPURenderer/TSL usage rules. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (manual/.md returns 404, and the human pages are hash-routed with no static URLs), plus independent or community corroboration of agents using these files successfully.
